title: Beau Lamarre-Condon’s explanations of body disposal ‘ring hollow’, court hears
summary_full: Former police officer has pleaded not guilty to murdering Jesse Baird and Luke Davies in Paddington in February 2024Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastBeau Lamarre-Condon knew he had murdered two men and his attempts to explain the disposal of their bodies “ring completely hollow”, a court has heard.Lamarre-Condon is accused of fatally shooting Jesse Baird and his new partner, Luke Davies, with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home in Sydney on 19 February 2024.
